h1:
Where to Stay on Koh Larn?
12 Places We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Twelve Koh Larn stays across every budget — private pool villas and beachfront resorts, down to value boutiques and Na Ban village guesthouses. Covering Tawaen Beach, Samae Beach, and the Na Ban village by the pier. Starting from around ฿900–7,200/night.
heroStats: 🏖️ 3 main areas (Tawaen Beach·Samae Beach·Na Ban village)
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right area on Koh Larn matter?
introHtml: Koh Larn is a small island just off Pattaya — about a 45-minute ferry from Bali Hai pier. Its areas feel quite different from one another — Tawaen Beach is the main and liveliest beach, with clear water, white sand, restaurants and water sports · Samae Beach is quieter with lovely water, good for relaxing by the sea · Na Ban village / pier is the island's main community, near the ferry pier, shops, market and the songthaew stop, where most of the budget stays are. Many travellers book without checking which area, then spend the whole trip taking songthaews or renting a scooter back and forth across the island, since Koh Larn has no city-style public transport. This guide brings together 12 Koh Larn stays we've reviewed across every tier — from private pool villas down to value village guesthouses. Every pick comes from reading real guest reviews, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Koh Larn has no city-style public transport. Getting to the island means a ferry from Bali Hai pier in Pattaya to Na Ban pier or Tawaen pier (the regular ferry takes about 45 minutes; speedboats are faster but pricier). On the island you get around by shared songthaew, by renting a scooter (around ฿300/day), or with your hotel's shuttle. The main areas in this guide: Tawaen Beach — the lively main beach, walk-to-sand stays (Rhy.a, Tiamo, At The Beach, Tarn-Tawan, Baan Sai Thong) · Samae Beach — quieter beach with lovely water (Xanadu) · near Tawaen / a quiet corner — leafy pool villa (SaroRach) · Na Ban village / pier — near the pier, shops, market, lighter prices (Lareena, Kampu, Rimtalay, White House, Sea Beach 1).

entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.8 · 52 reviews · Agoda 9.5 · near Tawaen Beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Near Tawaen Beach · quiet leafy corner · Koh Larn
tags: 🏊 Private pool + jacuzzi in every villa
entries.addr: 209/66 Moo 7, Na Ban, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this guide at 9.8 — SaroRach is a pool villa resort where every villa has its own private pool with a jacuzzi, rare on Koh Larn where most stays are budget guesthouses. Reviews most often mention the private pools with mood lighting at night, the very clean rooms, and the generous floating breakfast. It sits in a quiet, leafy corner near Tawaen Beach, with a free pier transfer — ideal for couples and small families who want privacy.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: When booking, check whether the rate includes the floating breakfast, and try the jacuzzi with the pool lights on in the evening — reviews mention the nighttime atmosphere often.

entries.name: Xanadu Beach Resort
entries.addr: Samae Beach, Koh Larn, Na Kluea, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri
entries.storyHtml: Xanadu is the most reviewed stay in this guide — over 754 reviews — a beachfront resort on Samae Beach, scoring 8.9. Reviews most often mention its spot right on Samae Beach (quieter than Tawaen, with clear water), the private beach with free deck chairs, and the seaside breakfast. With around 68 rooms you can walk straight from your room to the sand, and prices start at just ฿1,900 — good value for a beachfront stay on the island. Ideal if you want to sleep by the sea without paying villa rates.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a sea-view room when booking — some face Samae Beach directly. The in-room water is filtered seawater, so bring drinking water for washing up just in case.
pros: On Samae Beach, walk straight from your room to the sand (per reviews)
Private beach with free deck chairs, clear water
Most reviewed in the guide, 754 reviews, from ฿1,900
Seaside breakfast, well looked-after service
cons: In-room water is filtered seawater; some amenities not fully stocked
Building is showing its age; nights on the island are quiet

entries.name: Rhy.a Private Pool Villa
entries.badge: 🏝️ Modern pool villa near the beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tawaen Beach · walk to the sand · Koh Larn
entries.addr: Tawaen Beach, Koh Larn, Na Kluea, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri
entries.storyHtml: Rhy.a is a modern private pool villa just a few steps from Tawaen Beach, scoring 9.1. Reviews most often mention the bright, photogenic glass-and-exposed-concrete design, the private pool and jacuzzi in front of each villa, and the poolside breakfast served at your chosen time. It sits on the island's main beach, so it's easy to go for a swim then come back to soak in your own pool. It's the top price bracket on the island — ideal for couples who want a genuine private pool right by the beach.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Villas are few and reviews are still limited — book ahead and confirm details. The island's water system has its limits, so ask about hot water before booking.

entries.name: Lareena Resort Koh Larn Pattaya
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Ban pier · sea-view rooms · Koh Larn
entries.addr: 61/1 Moo 7, Na Ban, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri
entries.storyHtml: Lareena is a boutique resort right by Na Ban pier with plenty of reviews — 548 of them, scoring 9.0. Reviews most often mention how you step off the ferry and walk straight to your room, the easy walk to shops and the village market, and the affordable sea-facing rooms with balconies. It suits travellers who put convenience and a pier-side location first, with no long luggage drag. Rooms range from garden view up to a sea-facing suite and family rooms.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, step up to a Superior Sea Side or Suite On Sea for a sea-facing room with a balcony — better value than garden view. There's no pool, so pick elsewhere if a pool matters.

entries.name: Kampu Resort Kohlarn
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Ban village · near the pier · Koh Larn
entries.addr: Moo 7, Na Ban, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri
entries.storyHtml: Kampu is a small, good-value boutique resort in Na Ban village, scoring 9.0 from 53 reviews. Reviews most often mention the ฿1,600 starting rate with breakfast included, the free pier transfer, and a free scooter to ride around — which saves a lot on getting around the island. It suits budget travellers who spend the day out at the beaches and just come back to sleep, for far less than beachfront stays. Rooms are simple but clean, with cool air-con and hot water.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm the free scooter and pier transfer when booking. It's not beachfront and has no pool, so use the scooter to ride out to Tawaen or Samae Beach.

entries.name: Tiamo Kohlarn
entries.revCount: Booking 8.7 · 45 reviews · opened 2024 · near Tawaen Beach
entries.addr: 210/27 Moo 7, Na Ban, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri
entries.storyHtml: Tiamo is a boutique hotel that opened in 2024 with a swimming pool at an accessible price, scoring 8.7. Reviews most often mention the spotless new rooms, the attentive staff, the tasty breakfast, and the pool — rare in this price band on the island. The atmosphere is quiet and private, ideal for couples who want a clean new room. It's about 1 km from Tawaen Beach, so you'll walk or ride to the sand, but you get good-condition rooms and a pool for the price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, pick the Superior Sea View for a more open outlook. As a newly opened hotel some facilities are still being added, so ask when booking.

entries.storyHtml: Rimtalay is a small white-and-blue-themed resort where every room sees the sea, scoring 8.6 from 132 reviews. Reviews most often mention the Santorini-style photo corners, the rooftop pool and sea-view jacuzzi, breakfast included, and a private jetty. It sits on the Na Ban side facing Pattaya, quiet and good for couples. It suits travellers who come to Koh Larn to relax and take photos rather than to swim hard, since the front of the resort isn't a walk-in sandy beach.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for an upper-floor Sea View Room for a more open outlook; if the budget allows, try the Ocean Villa or King Suite with a tub. There are notes about water pressure and bathroom lighting — ask before booking.

It suits budget travellers who put price and cleanliness first, for around a thousand baht and change. It's a simple, no-frills base for people who spend the day at the beaches and come back to sleep.

entries.storyHtml: Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 is the cheapest starting price in this guide — from just ฿900, scoring 7.8 from 128 reviews. Reviews most often mention the ~200 m walk in from Na Ban pier, being near a 7-Eleven and the songthaew stop, and roomy ~25 sqm rooms with cool air-con and hot water. It suits very budget-minded travellers who put a pier-side location and a roomy space first. It's a simple, low-cost base for short trips.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pay a little more for an upper-floor room for a more open outlook and better view. Cleanliness and room condition are inconsistent — check recent reviews, and some services cost extra, so ask first.

advice.bodyHtml: → Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 ฿900, roomy and near the pier · or Kampu Resort ฿1,600 with breakfast, free pier transfer and free scooter

advice.head: Sleep by the beach, walk to the sand
advice.bodyHtml: → Xanadu Beach Resort ฿1,900 on Samae Beach with clear water and free deck chairs · or Baan Sai Thong ฿900 on Tawaen Beach at a light price

advice.head: Want a pool villa with a private pool
advice.bodyHtml: → SaroRach Pool Villa Resort ฿4,400, private pool + jacuzzi in every villa, score 9.8 · or Rhy.a Private Pool Villa ฿7,200, modern pool villa by Tawaen Beach

advice.head: Couples trip, photogenic stay
advice.bodyHtml: → Rimtalay Resort ฿1,800, white-and-blue theme, every room sea-view, rooftop pool · or Tiamo Kohlarn ฿2,200, spotless new rooms with a pool

advice.head: Stay by the pier, no long luggage drag
advice.bodyHtml: → Lareena Resort ฿2,450 right by Na Ban pier with sea-view rooms · or At The Beach Koh Larn Resort ฿1,500, step off the ferry to your room

advice.head: Travelling as a family with kids
advice.bodyHtml: → Xanadu Beach Resort Family Room ฿3,400, beachfront · or SaroRach Family Pool Villa ฿5,500 with a private pool

advice.head: Bringing a pet
advice.bodyHtml: → Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel ฿1,200, a small stay by Na Ban pier that allows pets — rare on the island

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are indicative and can change by date and season. Most Koh Larn stays are guesthouses and small resorts, so prices swing hard on weekends and long holidays — always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking. Good rooms and pool villas are few and fill fast on holidays, so book ahead. Getting to Koh Larn means a ferry from Bali Hai pier in Pattaya, about 45 minutes. The island has no public transport — use songthaews, rent a scooter, or your hotel's shuttle. Article by ThailandAddict.
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Koh Larn stays

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay on Koh Larn?
faq.a: It depends on your style · Tawaen Beach suits those who want to sleep by the lively main beach, with clear water and water sports (Rhy.a, Tiamo, Baan Sai Thong) · Samae Beach suits those who want a quieter beach with lovely water (Xanadu) · Na Ban village / pier suits those who value being near the pier, shops, market and lighter prices (Lareena, Kampu, Rimtalay, White House, Sea Beach 1) · You can reach every area by scooter or songthaew.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Koh Larn stays cost?
faq.a: Prices vary a lot: guesthouses and budget stays in Na Ban village start around ฿900–1,600 per night · beachfront resorts and boutiques run ฿1,800–3,400 · private pool villas start from ฿4,400–7,200+ · Prices on weekends and long holidays (Songkran, New Year) climb hard and rooms fill very fast.

faq.q: ❓ Are there private pool villas on Koh Larn?
faq.a: Yes, but not many, as most island stays are guesthouses and small resorts · The genuine private-pool villas in this guide are SaroRach Pool Villa Resort (pool + jacuzzi in every villa, score 9.8) and Rhy.a Private Pool Villa (a modern pool villa by Tawaen Beach) · Tiamo and Rimtalay have a shared/rooftop pool at lighter prices.

faq.q: ❓ How do you get to Koh Larn and get around the island?
faq.a: Take a ferry from Bali Hai pier in Pattaya to Koh Larn — the regular ferry is about 45 minutes (speedboats are faster but pricier), landing at Na Ban pier or Tawaen pier · The island has no city-style public transport — get around by shared songthaew, by renting a scooter (around ฿300/day), or with your hotel's shuttle · Many stays offer a pier transfer; tell them your ferry time ahead.

faq.q: ❓ Should you stay on the beach or near the pier?
faq.a: On the beach (Xanadu on Samae, Baan Sai Thong/Rhy.a on Tawaen) suits you if you plan to swim all day and walk to the sand from your room — but nights are quiet with fewer dining options · Near Na Ban pier (Lareena, Kampu, White House, Sea Beach 1) suits you if you don't want a long luggage drag, want shops and the market nearby, and lighter prices — but you ride or take a songthaew to the beaches · Without your own transport, pick a stay with a pier shuttle.

faq.q: ❓ Is there anything to do at night on Koh Larn?
faq.a: Nights on Koh Larn are fairly quiet, with few evening activities — mostly seaside restaurants and small shops in Na Ban village · The upside is a peaceful atmosphere good for relaxing, but if you want bars, a night market or lively nightlife you'll take the ferry back to Pattaya (the last ferry runs at a limited time, so check the schedule first).
